title: Warrant of Execution
notes: Judge-authored document, like Order to Release — no separate citizen applicant role.

fields.label: Chambers of / Signature
fields.prompt: Which judge/justice is issuing this warrant?
fields.note: Appears in the 'Chambers of' header (plain) and the signature block (cursive).

fields.label: Case Name
fields.prompt: What is the case name (e.g. State v. Defendant)?

fields.label: Trial Date
fields.prompt: What date was the trial held?

fields.label: Charge
fields.prompt: What charge was the defendant found guilty of?

fields.label: Capital Punishment Order Number
fields.prompt: What is the SC-DOJ Capital Punishment order number?

fields.label: Appeals Period Start
fields.prompt: When does the appeals period begin?

fields.label: Appeals Period Expiry
fields.prompt: When does the appeals period expire?

fields.label: Preparation Period Start
fields.prompt: When does the Department of Corrections' preparation period begin?

fields.label: Earliest Execution Time
fields.prompt: What is the earliest the execution may take place?

fields.label: Judge's Rank
fields.prompt: What is the issuing judge's rank?
